title: BBVA helps design a common protocol led by Sierra AI and Meta to connect AI agents with businesses
hook_text: AI agents just got a common language
script:
Meta and Sierra AI are creating a new protocol to connect AI agents with businesses.
Spanish bank BBVA is helping design this framework to improve how these digital agents function.
The goal is to allow AI to perform complex actions across different corporate platforms.
This protocol addresses the need for a shared standard in the rapidly growing AI sector.
BBVA aims to use this to better integrate AI into its existing banking services.
The collaboration focuses on technical interoperability between various systems.
Would you trust an AI agent to manage your banking transactions?
